_comment: Runtime config applied via Settings → Import. Merges over your current settings.
_internalDomains: Hosts under these suffixes are infrastructure: they keep deterministic per-subdomain groups and never go to the AI, so two clusters are never merged by topic.
_pinnedRules: Force specific URLs into a fixed group. Prefer TASK-shaped rules (capture the project/ticket key) over host-shaped ones — a rule like 'github.com = Code' recreates the hostname grouping that task grouping exists to avoid. First match wins, so list specific rules first.
